title: An EL-shellable rank-uniform poset that is not UMEL-shellable
summary: We address Questions~8.1 and~8.4 of Coron--Ferroni--Li \cite{coron2025chow}. For the first part of Question~8.1, which asks whether every rank-uniform EL-shellable poset admits a rank-uniform EL-labeling, we construct a counterexample of rank $4$ and prove that this rank is minimal. For the second part of Question~8.1, concerning whether every rank-uniform EL-shellable poset is UMEL-shellable, we construct a counterexample of rank $3$.
